key_insight: CeAuAl₃ is identified as a Kondo–Kramers nodal-line material, linking strong electronic correlations with symmetry-protected topological band degeneracies.
engineering_relevance: The findings offer a materials-screening strategy for correlated topological conductors that combine achiral, non-centrosymmetric crystal structures with Kondo physics.
method: Tight-binding toy models of symmetry breaking
evidence_signal: Calculations identify nodal lines along Γ–Z and X–P, while measurements show a large anomalous Hall effect below the Kondo temperature, extending above magnetic ordering.
watch_item: The abstract supports the nodal-line interpretation through calculations and transport but does not report direct spectroscopic observation.
paper_title: Discovery of Kondo-Kramers Nodal Line Topological State in strongly correlated material CeAuAl$_3$
